footer.about: Dédale is the home of interactive books: read, write and publish branching stories, in every genre.
footer.madeIn: Designed in Paris, for readers and writers everywhere.

landing.title: Stories where you hold <thread>the thread</thread>.
landing.subtitle: On Dédale, every choice draws a path. Read stories that answer back, write your own without a line of code, and publish them to thousands of readers.
landing.demoSubtitle: A thirty-second story. No account needed.
landing.readersTitle: You are no longer a spectator.
landing.readersBody: Dice tests, inventory, combat, secret endings: the mechanics of classic gamebooks, in the service of every genre. And after each choice, see what other readers did.
landing.readersPoint1: Ariadne's thread: a map of your journey and of the paths still unexplored
landing.readersPoint2: Offline reading on mobile, synced across your devices
landing.readersPoint3: Reading comfort: dyslexia-friendly fonts, read-aloud, themes
landing.authorsTitle: Become the architect of your labyrinths.
landing.authorsBody: A visual graph editor, conditions in plain language, a simulator that plays a thousand games for you to measure difficulty and length, and analytics that show where your readers hesitate.
landing.authorsPoint1: Instant detection of dead ends and orphan passages
landing.authorsPoint2: Twine import, numbered paper gamebook export
landing.authorsPoint3: 70% of sales for you — 85% on your first €10,000
landing.schoolsTitle: Grow readers by giving them the power to write.
landing.schoolsBody: Whole classes co-write branching stories: logic, imagination and language skills in a single project.
landing.value1Body: You pay to read a work, never to unlock an option halfway through a story.
landing.value2Body: A published story stays readable, archived and exportable in an open format.
landing.value3Title: AI behind the scenes, not instead
landing.value3Body: Muse helps writers proofread and imagine; every story discloses its use of AI.

landing.featureEndings: possible endings, one of them secret

pricing.shareBody: Half of every subscription goes to writers, based on what you actually read: your subscription funds your writers, not the biggest names in the catalogue.

faq.a1: Yes. The free catalogue is unlimited and ad-free, and your saves are synced even with a free account.
faq.q2: Why are there no paid choices?
faq.a2: Because a narrative choice should never depend on your wallet. You buy a work, not an option halfway through the story.
faq.a3: 70% of every sale (85% on the first €10,000), 95% of tips and 50% of subscriptions, redistributed according to your reading.
faq.a4: Yes, in one click from your account. Your readings and discovered endings remain yours.

schools.title: What if your students wrote the book the whole class will read?
schools.subtitle: A collaborative writing project combining language skills, logic and creativity — from primary to high school.
schools.point1Body: Each group writes a branch of the story; the editor flags inconsistencies and dead ends.
schools.point2Body: Student accounts without email, age-filtered catalogue, no data resold, hosted in Europe.
schools.point3Body: Ready-made lesson plans, assessment grids and a printed edition of the class book.
schools.pricing: Free for pilot classes, then €99 per class per year — eligible for school cultural funding.

charter.title: Ethics charter
charter.intro: Dédale welcomes every story and every genre, within a few simple principles.

rules.r1: No sexually explicit or hateful content, and no glorification of violence.
rules.r2: Works carry an age rating and flag sensitive content.
rules.r3: Plagiarism is forbidden; Creative Commons licenses are respected and displayed.
rules.r4: The use of artificial intelligence is disclosed on every story.
rules.r5: Feedback to writers stays kind and constructive.
rules.r6: No gambling mechanics, no paid narrative choices.
